The structure of Zn3Te (Zn12Te4) is hexagonal, space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 16 atoms in the unit cell and three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Te centers with 12 Zn neighbors and Zn centers with 10 neighbors (5 Te, 5 Zn), with neighbor distances of 2.7742–3.0548 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face sharing between Te and Zn polyhedra, and corner and edge sharing among Zn polyhedra.
